_README: PLACEHOLDER VALUES. Nothing here has been measured on the arm yet. Replace each value from robot/BRINGUP.md (K0) and robot/SETUP.md (K4), then remove its key from 'placeholders'. robot/arm.py refuses to connect with the placeholder serial and refuses to home() to a placeholder start pose.
_force_sign: K0 question 5: +1 if pushing the handle toward +x gives ext_wrench_in_world[0] > 0, else -1. Arm reports force = force_sign * ext_wrench_in_world[:3] so that force is what the PERSON applies.
_reach_axis: Base axis of the forward reach: 0 = x, 1 = y. The workspace box (0.35 m along the reach, 0.10 m across and up) is laid out along it.
_start_pose: K0 question 7 / K4: tcp_pose is x, y, z (m) then qw, qx, qy, qz in the world frame. q is the 7 joint angles (rad) or null.
